profile.headline: Freelance Web Developer and Co-owner of Creative Agency
profile.summary:
I'm a web developer and small business owner seeking new opportunities in the web.

Web Skills: HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, JQuery, PHP, Wordpress , Shopify, Git.

Other Tools/Skills:  Sass,  Grunt, basic UX/UI, Responsive Design, Accessibility, Chrome and Mozilla Developer Tools, Bootstrap, Sublime and Brackets Text Editors, Photoshop and Illustrator, HTML email templates and MailChimp

I work in a Windows (XAMPP) environment and have a basic understanding of Linux

If you'd like to collaborate and/or work with me or if you'd like to offer me work or advice, please feel free to email me at hannah@coderjones.com.

If you have any creative design needs, please visit PixelWaveDesigns.com or email us at info@PixelWaveDesigns.com.
